text:
sam_sales: Quick sync 1 Aurelia Systems is asking for a 2-week POC but their CISO tightened identity requirements. Need to confirm SSO/SCIM/RBAC + domain lock before we hand over.

iris_se: I can take this. Major asks?

aurelia_it: They need SAML IdP+SP initiated, SCIM v2 with delta + bulk import, explicit role attribute on SCIM Group -> map into tenant RBAC, delegated tenant admins, domain-locked provisioning (file upload accepted for POC), SIEM forwarding for audit logs, and BYOK w/ HSM attestation. CISO wants answers by Wed.

leo_security: Security checklist: BYOK (AWS/GCP/Azure KMS) required and non-exportable keys. They mention FIPS/HSM - we can provide attestation pack. They want audit retention 365d and proof of rotation events.

maya_pm: Product notes: Dedicated trial OK. Default audit retention 90d; enterprise opt-ins for 180/365 available (adds delay to provisioning). SIEM forwarding supported via HTTP webhook or syslog connector. File upload domain verification is manual for POC (support ticket) and triggers cert issuance after verification.

iris_se: SCIM specifics: endpoints /Users and /Groups, ChangeLog for deltas. Rate limits: 1200 ops/min for enterprise POC. Bulk import over 40k users handled by async job. Current RBAC engine does not auto-consume a "role" SCIM attribute into tenant roles. Workaround options below.

iris_se: Workaround 1 (admin API): post mapping after sync. Example:

curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/admin/role-mappings \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"group":"okta:aurelia-admins","role":"tenant_admin"}'

iris_se: Workaround 2 (event lambda): small sync that watches SCIM ChangeLog for Group objects with role attribute and calls the admin mapping API automatically. We can provide a sample lambda for POC.

toni_billing: Credits we can offer: 275k tokens/day for the 2-week POC. Anything above needs a short paid uplift or minimal commit. I can send a one-page SOW with overage rates.

leo_security: For questionnaire: confirm KMS integrations, rotation support, keys non-exportable, and provide HSM attestation pack on request. We'll also include instructions for forwarding rotation events to their SIEM during POC.

deploy_bot: sso_scan: aurelia-idp metadata validation passed (scan 3111111400) :white_check_mark:

aurelia_it: Domain file will be uploaded today. Expected user count ~45k, peak tokens/day estimate 600k during demos. Concerned about chunking for bulk import and peak token costs.

maya_pm: Note caveat: enabling 365d retention and manual domain verification may add 24-48 hours to POC setup. We'll communicate that. Also automated role-mapping UI is planned in a future release; admin-API/lambda is recommended for POC.

iris_se: Action items: I'll draft a short runbook (SSO screenshots, SCIM chunking guidance, mapping lambda sample). Toni -> SOW/credits and overage path. Leo -> assemble security Q answers + attestation docs. Maya -> schedule tech preflight and note caveats in deal tracker.

sam_sales: Thanks team. I'll tell Aurelia to expect manual verification window and ask them to confirm upload ticket. Scheduling preflight for tomorrow 10am PT.
